name: wendy-agentic-coding
description: Wendy CLI setup, device installation and first-boot checks, template apps, explicit deployment targets, ROS 2 and robot verification workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Install devices and build, deploy, and debug Wendy apps.
interface.longDescription: Set up Wendy CLI and MCP, install and verify a device, create an app, configure permissions, deploy to an explicit target, and verify app or robot behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use Wendy to install Wendy CLI and verify device discovery.
Use Wendy to create a Wendy app from the closest template in wendylabsinc/templates.
Use Wendy to initialize or validate this Wendy project.
Use Wendy to choose wendy.json entitlements for this app.
Use Wendy to inspect this WendyOS device with CLI-native device ops.
Use Wendy to configure Wendy MCP for this assistant.
Use Wendy to run this app detached and stream logs.
Use Wendy to debug this WendyOS device runtime issue from logs to root cause.
Use Wendy to plan this device installation and verify its first boot.
Use Wendy to deploy this robot app in simulation and verify its sensor and stop behavior.
